confounds: Horizon: survival here is same-session (killed within the run), and the git numerator is measured at HEAD over '30.days.ago'. Not a durable day/week horizon.
Effort mix: sessions span effort tiers high, max, unknown; the blended topline can move on an effort-mix shift rather than an engine change. Slice by_effort to hold it fixed.
Review regime uncontrolled: no fingerprint labels, so the review dimension is neither held fixed nor sliced. Run the classifier (SKILL.md step 3b) to control for this confound.

Task difficulty uncontrolled (selection): efficiency = survival-rate x production-rate, and the efficiency leader 'solo' wins on survival-rate (93%, stickier work), not token-thrift, it produces 117,685 per Mtok while 'workflow' produces 329,005 (2.8x) at 29% survival. So the raw efficiency ordering is difficulty-mixed, not a thrift ranking; hold the task fixed with the dynamometer (same task, different rigs) before reading it as one.
